name: Cabinet
description: A lightweight self-hosted file cabinet and document manager.
summary: Cabinet v0.5.0 (2026-07-04) is the largest release since v0.4.0, introducing Connect Knowledge for cloud drive integration (Google Drive, iCloud, OneDrive, Dropbox), a 52-connector Integrations Hub (Slack, Google, Microsoft 365, Snowflake, LinkedIn, Discord, Telegram), per-room agent Channels, and a Telegram remote-control gateway. Notable fixes include PBKDF2 password hashing with rate-limiting (auth hardening), Windows installer repairs, and clean-path routing replacing hash-based routing. v0.6.0 introduces a self-update mechanism, with future releases published at https://github.com/cabinetai/cabinet-releases.

answers.Is the project actively maintained?: Yes — v0.5.0 released 2026-07-04 with 238 commits, v0.6.0 followed shortly after
answers.Does it support user authentication?: Yes — PBKDF2 password hashing with per-install salt, login rate-limiting, and KB_PASSWORD gate for daemon auth

breaking_excerpts: Clean-path routing: the app serves clean URLs instead of hash routes across web and Electron. Old hash links resolve via a marker-scan parser, but the canonical form is now path-based.
Channels on-disk rename: the internal team-chat directory moved from `.slack` to `.channels`, scoped per room.
v0.6.0 moves the update mechanism to a new updater; future releases are published at https://github.com/cabinetai/cabinet-releases instead of the original repository.

alternatives.name: Paperless-ngx
alternatives.review: Paperless-ngx offers far more powerful OCR, tagging, and full-text search than Cabinet but requires more resources and setup complexity.

alternatives.name: Teedy
alternatives.review: Teedy is a more feature-rich document management system with workflows and user permissions, but is heavier and more complex to deploy than Cabinet.

alternatives.name: Docspell
alternatives.review: Docspell provides automatic document classification and multi-user support but has a steeper configuration curve compared to Cabinet's lightweight approach.

alternatives.name: Nextcloud
alternatives.review: Nextcloud is a full-featured cloud platform with file management capabilities, but it is significantly heavier and broader in scope than the focused simplicity of Cabinet.

alternatives.name: Mayan EDMS
alternatives.review: Mayan EDMS is an enterprise-grade document management system with advanced workflows and ACLs, making it far more powerful but considerably more complex than Cabinet.
